questions.prompt: What is the boy who fears the storm writing in the dark?
questions.answer: Quid puer quī tempestātem timet in tenebrīs scrībit?

questions.prompt: How many books that wise old man has written!
questions.answer: Quot librōs ille senex sapiēns scrīpsit!

questions.prompt: Praise the frugality of the ancients, my son, and flee luxury!
questions.answer: Frūgālitātem antīquōrum laudā, mī fīlī, et lūxuriam fuge!

questions.prompt: The soldiers, having conquered the enemy, returned to the camp with great joy.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs, hostibus victīs, magnō cum gaudiō ad castra rediērunt.

questions.prompt: Why did the queen conceal the truth from her faithful companions?
questions.answer: Cūr rēgīna vērum ā fīdīs comitibus cēlāvit?

questions.prompt: How bravely those young men defended the walls of the city!
questions.answer: Quam fortiter illī iuvenēs moenia urbis dēfendērunt!

questions.prompt: Do not despise the poor, but help them with a generous hand.
questions.answer: Nōlī pauperēs contemnere, sed eōs largā manū adiuvā.

questions.prompt: A small child, weeping in the road, sought its mother in vain.
questions.answer: Parvus puer, in viā flēns, mātrem frūstrā quaesīvit.

questions.prompt: How long will you endure the arrogance of that cruel tyrant?
questions.answer: Quamdiū superbiam illīus crūdēlis tyrannī patiēris?

questions.prompt: What a sweet kiss the mother gave to her sleeping infant!
questions.answer: Quam dulce suāvium māter dormientī īnfantī dedit!

questions.prompt: Because the road was open, the merchants traveled safely through the mountains.
questions.answer: Quia via pervia erat, mercātōrēs tūtō per montēs iter fēcērunt.

questions.prompt: By what plan did the general seize the citadel without bloodshed?
questions.answer: Quō cōnsiliō dux arcem sine caede cēpit?

questions.prompt: How wretched are those who neglect the love of their friends!
questions.answer: Quam miserī sunt eī quī amīcōrum dīlēctiōnem neglegunt!

questions.prompt: Why are you carrying so much gold through the dangerous mountains?
questions.answer: Cūr tantum aurī per montēs perīculōsōs gestās?

questions.prompt: How great is the courage of the soldiers fighting for their fatherland!
questions.answer: Quanta est virtūs mīlitum prō patriā pugnantium!

questions.prompt: Mix the herbs with wine and drink the remedy, my friend.
questions.answer: Miscē herbās vīnō et remedium bibe, amīce.

questions.prompt: The wounded soldier, thrown back by the enemy, hid his bruise with his cloak.
questions.answer: Mīles vulnerātus, ab hostibus reiectus, līvōrem palliō cēlāvit.

questions.prompt: What are the merchants seeking while their ship floats on the wide sea?
questions.answer: Quid mercātōrēs petunt dum nāvis in marī lātō fluitat?

questions.prompt: How boldly the young man approached the swollen mass of waters!
questions.answer: Quam audācter iuvenis mōlem aquārum tumentem adgressus est!

questions.prompt: Do not reject the gifts offered by a faithful friend.
questions.answer: Nōlī dōna ab amīcō fidēlī oblāta reicere.

questions.prompt: Curiosity, though pleasant, often leads careless men into danger.
questions.answer: Cūriōsitās, quamquam iūcunda, saepe hominēs incautōs in perīculum dūcit.

questions.prompt: Whom did the queen send to the king across the wide fields?
questions.answer: Quem rēgīna ad rēgem trāns lātōs campōs mīsit?

questions.prompt: How wide is the breadth of the plain stretching before our eyes!
questions.answer: Quanta est lātitūdō campī ante oculōs nostrōs patentis!

questions.prompt: Encourage the weary cohorts and lead them back to the walls.
questions.answer: Cohortāre fessās cohortēs et redūc eās ad mūrōs.
